items.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023
items.q: I was thinking the other day you know Miles gave us “My Funny Valentine” but he also gave us “Four.” He also gave us “Sketches of Spain.” He also gave us “In a Silent Way.”

ctx.x: You know you’re putting a word to it, and the word goes with a note that people may expect but you’re choosing a different note supposedly on purpose.

Huh. Well that’s a great question. I’ve never been asked that question. I’m just reminded of someone walking up to Miles Davis and saying, “Man that was amazing on that record you did with” da-da-da-da. And how did you — where did you come up with [scats].” And he will say, “It was a mistake.” The person is like — but and then Betty Carter would always say, “When you make a mistake it’s how you recover.” Okay? That’s it. That’s the answer. It’s how — okay and that’s Betty’s answer and she is a great singer, all…
Yeah that makes people put their drink down and go, “Wait a minute” — © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
